title: Split the OpenAPI document builder
notes: - `buildOpenApiDocument.ts` was 309 lines: five schema literals, a wrapper
helper and seven path definitions all inside one function. The schemas, the
`{ data }` wrapper and the shared error response are now their own files
under `services/api/openapi/`, and the paths are three groups by audience:
the unauthenticated health and metrics probes, the admin job and self-update
endpoints, and the webhook CRUD. The builder is a 42-line assembler that
evidence: the served document is unchanged, proved rather than assumed. A scratch test dumped `buildOpenApiDocument()` to JSON on the split code and again on the pre-split code recovered from HEAD: both are 13,441 bytes and compare equal, with the same seven paths. The scratch test was removed afterwards. `pnpm run check:ci` green, `pnpm run check:quality` green once the unused internal barrel was deleted - `openapi/` is internal to the api slice, so it is reached relatively and has no public entrypoint.

ledger 384 findings / 235 files before, 376 / 234 after, with `sonarjs/cognitive-complexity` now at zero. `pnpm run check:ci` green (76 files / 542 tests), `pnpm test:a11y` 17 files / 47 tests, `pnpm run check:quality` green with no dependency violations over 1,692 modules.
